# HackerEarth

> > HackerEarth is a global technical recruitment and developer community platform that connects companies with 10M+ developers across 133 countries for hiring, assessments, and innovation challenges.

HackerEarth provides end-to-end recruitment solutions including online coding assessments, live interview platforms, hackathons, and hiring challenges. The platform serves tech recruiters, hiring managers, and developers with tools for technical talent evaluation, skill development, and community engagement.

## Key Topics

- Technical Recruitment
- Coding Assessments
- Developer Assessment
- Hiring Platform
- Live Coding Interviews
- Skill Evaluation
- Campus Hiring
- Hackathons
- Code Compiler API
- Proctoring
- AI-powered Hiring
- Remote Hiring
- Talent Evaluation
- Interview Preparation
- Developer Community

## Recruitment & Hiring Solutions

- [Online Recruitment Platform for Tech Recruiters](https://www.hackerearth.com/recruit/tech-recruiters): Tech recruiter platform with coding tests and candidate screening for 100+ roles
- [Interview Platform for Hiring Managers](https://www.hackerearth.com/recruit/hiring-managers): Developer screening platform to assess and hire top coding talent efficiently
- [Online Coding Tests & Assessments](https://www.hackerearth.com/recruit/assessments): Online coding tests with proctoring to screen and evaluate developer talent
- [Live Coding Interview Platform - FaceCode](https://www.hackerearth.com/recruit/facecode): Live coding interview platform with real-time collaboration across 41+ languages
- [Hiring Challenges](https://www.hackerearth.com/recruit/hiring-challenge): Hiring challenges to source pre-assessed developers from 10M+ community

## Specialized Hiring Programs

- [University Recruiting Software - Campus Hiring Platform](https://www.hackerearth.com/recruit/university-hiring): Campus recruitment platform for remote student assessment and interviews
- [Virtual Recruiting Software - Remote Hiring Platform](https://www.hackerearth.com/recruit/remote-hiring): Virtual recruiting platform for remote assessments and global candidate interviews
- [Employee Skill Assessment Software - Learning & Development Platform](https://www.hackerearth.com/recruit/learning-and-development): L&D platform for employee upskilling and tech skills assessment and development

## Community & Innovation Platforms

- [Online Hackathon Platform](https://www.hackerearth.com/recruit/hackathons): Hackathon platform connecting 10M+ developers across 133 countries globally
- [AI Hackathon Platform](https://www.hackerearth.com/recruit/ai-hackathons-for-innovation): AI hackathon platform for innovation challenges with generative AI support
- [For Developers - Resources for Technical Recruitment](https://www.hackerearth.com/for-developers): Developer resources for coding practice, interview prep, and skill development

## AI-Powered Tools & Interview Prep

- [Helix - AI-Led Mock Interview Platform](https://helix.hackerearth.com): AI-led mock interview platform for interview prep and job readiness scoring

## API & Developer Tools

- [Online Code Compiler API](https://www.hackerearth.com/recruit/api): Code Compiler API for secure code execution across 40+ programming languages
